mechanism.claim: In a high-variation completed BTC auction, a same-direction spot and perpetual move is more durable when Binance spot's share of combined spot-plus-perpetual quote turnover rises materially from the first four hours to the second four hours and the final two-hour perpetual move still confirms the auction. Follow the cash-sponsored direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour spot return, perpetual return, and final-two-hour perpetual return
mechanism.why_distinct: SPVIR uses an hourly upper-tail level of spot base-volume share plus BVOL/DVOL ignition; STCSR uses a daily spot share of transaction count; HVSFLR compares spot/perpetual aggressive-flow imbalance levels; DCVPR rotates Upbit versus Binance participation over a day. HVCPMR uses the within-auction first difference of Binance spot quote-turnover share across two disjoint four-hour halves, without implied volatility, taker direction, Upbit, funding, OI, fitted outcomes, prior events, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour perpetual realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, targeting July-like volatile markets
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: new onsets of offset intrablock cash-share migration with three-way directional confirmation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.window: exact aligned 480 one-minute BTCUSDT rows [D-8h,D) from bars_binance_spot and bars_binance
features.half_share: sum spot quote_asset_volume / sum(spot plus perpetual quote_asset_volume) separately over exact first and second 240-minute halves
features.migration: second-half share minus first-half share, strictly positive
features.migration_rank: strict-prior midrank of positive migration against at most 270 prior source-valid positive migrations; minimum 180; current excluded; rank at least 0.70
features.returns: spot and perpetual log(last close/first open) over full block, plus perpetual final-two-hour log return; all strict nonzero and same sign
features.btc_variation: sum squared perpetual log(close/open) over exact 1440 one-minute rows [D-24h,D)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 270 prior source-valid decisions; minimum 180; current excluded; rank at least 0.65
features.trigger: false-to-true onset of migration tail, variation, and directional confirmation against previous source-valid decision
features.invalid: missing/duplicate/nonpositive/incoherent OHLC, negative volume, nonpositive combined turnover, or incomplete aligned grids; no imputation

clock.entry: exact perpetual BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90 audit; no venue, volume field, block, half, migration, history, rank, confirmation, variation, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
